name: Authorize.net Payments for WooCommerce
author: Authorize.net

sections.description:
This plugin integrates Authorize.net into your WooCommerce store, offering payment methods such as Credit Card, eCheck.
Securely store customer payment details with our Customer information Manager Services.
Utilize Authorize.net Advanced Fraud Detection Suite prevention services to process transactions safely.
Compatible with WooCommerce Subscriptions

sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire “authorize-net-payments-for-woocommerce” folder to the “/wp-content/plugins/” directory in your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings in WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → Authorize.net Payments for WooCommerce.

For full documentation, please visit our documentation center
sections.faq:
How can I test credit card transactions?

Configure Plugin in “Sandbox” Environment. Then submit an order with valid billing address and payment information according to our test documentation

What are the required credentials to set up the plugin?

You will need your Authorize.net API Login ID, Transaction Key, and Client Key for both the sandbox (test) and production environments. The required credentials can be obtained from their respective environments, as described in our user guide. For additional information please visit Support or contact your reseller.

How do I get support with this plugin?

In most cases we can provide support through the WordPress or WooCommerce forums. In some cases we may need you to contact our Support Team or your reseller, if some information is required that should not be in the public domain.

How can I get a sandbox account?

Sign up here.
